events.title: ExPRO Fitness Summit & Festival 2026
events.price: Festival day pass $45; two-day VIP pass $299
events.description: Perth's fitness festival returns to the Scarborough Beach foreshore for a third year. One day is a professional summit for trainers, coaches and gym owners (VIP pass holders, 18+); the festival day is open to everyone, with beach workouts, group training, Pilates and dance fitness sessions, workshops, a fitness expo and marketplace, DJs, and family and youth activities. Bring activewear, water, a hat and sunscreen, and a towel or mat for the beach sessions.
